rationale: All 6 blocking findings from the final round are resolved. CR-001: setTheme() now calls saveProfileSettings fire-and-forget after applyTheme. CR-002: 404 auto-create reads localStorage before seeding and isOnboardingCompleted uses explicit null check. CR-003: error path leaves profileSettings null; applyBackendTheme gated on !error. CR-004: Apache 2.0 headers added to all 4 Python files. CR-005: saveProfileSettings wrapped in try/catch with re-throw. CR-006: all fire-and-forget call sites (.5 total) have .catch() handlers. Combined diff contained unrelated uncommitted working-tree changes (poetry.lock, pyproject.toml, .env, .claude/settings.json) that are out of scope; fix-up commits are clean. A later commit on this same branch/MR added AI Adoption Config persistence, reviewed and fixed up separately, folded in here: all 4 findings (CR-007 through CR-010) resolved — critical serialization-size fix independently re-verified in the real environment, GET now guards against corrupted data, PUT rejects malformed/out-of-bounds bodies with 400, and resetAiAdoptionConfig now matches saveAiAdoptionConfig's loading/error pattern.

finding_status.notes: themeService.ts setTheme() now imports profileSettingsStore and calls saveProfileSettings(userId, { theme }).catch() after applyTheme. Backend is now updated on every user-initiated theme change.

404 auto-create path now checks localStorage.getItem('codemie-onboarding-completed') before seeding completed state. isOnboardingCompleted in appInfo.ts replaced ?? with explicit !== null guard, making localStorage fallback reachable.

Error path in fetchProfileSettings no longer assigns DEFAULT_PROFILE to profileSettings (now leaves null with comment). useInitialDataFetch gates applyBackendTheme inside !profileSettingsStore.error check, preserving localStorage theme on network failures.
Apache 2.0 license header block added to user_profile_settings.py (model), user_profile_settings_repository.py, user_profile_settings_service.py, and user_profile_settings_router.py.
saveProfileSettings now has try/catch that logs via console.error and re-throws so awaited callers receive the rejection and can handle it.

All fire-and-forget saveProfileSettings calls now have .catch() handlers: completeFlow and markPageVisited in onboarding.ts, deleteRecentAssistant and updateRecentAssistants in assistants.ts, setViewedAppVersion in appInfo.ts (also changed from await to fire-and-forget with local state set first).

value=json.dumps(config.model_dump()) replaces value=json.dumps(config.to_dict()) in save_ai_adoption_config; get_ai_adoption_config reconstructs via AIAdoptionConfig(**json.loads(record.value)) instead of from_dict(). Test updated to assert flat shape and len<=10000. Independently re-verified in the real environment: 3,902 chars, round-trips to identical to_dict() output.

get_ai_adoption_config wraps the persisted-record parse in try/except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, TypeError), logs a warning, and falls back to AIAdoptionConfig() defaults. New test test_config_falls_back_to_defaults_when_persisted_value_is_corrupted covers it.

update_ai_adoption_config wraps AIAdoptionConfig.from_dict(request_body) in try/except (ValueError, TypeError), raising ExtendedHTTPException(400). Two new tests cover both the structural-malformed-body case and the out-of-bounds-value case (also closes the Testing Plan gap noted in business_review).

resetAiAdoptionConfig now sets this.loading[key]/this.error[key] around the api.delete call with a finally block clearing loading, mirroring saveAiAdoptionConfig exactly. Two new tests cover the success-clears-loading and failure-sets-error-and-rethrows paths.
